name: Insta360 Studio Mod Suite
description: 2.4x Export Speedup (Denoise Bypass), Universal Custom LUT Support, Live LUT Switcher, Unlocked Color Adjustments, and Default Motion ND Off

patches.name: Dynamic Export Denoise Hook (Call Site)
patches.description: Reroutes export pipeline denoiser instantiation to dynamic helper that checks C:\Users\Public\denoise.flag (controlled by export dialog toggle).

patches.name: Dynamic Export Denoise Helper (.text Cave)
patches.description: Helper function in .text cave that queries GetFileAttributesA. If denoise.flag exists, branches to stock denoiser; if absent, returns 0 to skip denoiser (preserving grain + 2.4x speed).
patches.instructions_patched: sub rsp, 28h; lea rcx, flag; call GetFileAttributesA; add rsp, 28h; cmp eax, -1; je skip; mov edx, ebx; mov rcx, rsi; jmp real_func; skip: xor eax, eax; ret

patches.name: Motion ND Export Bypass (ProjectExporter)
patches.description: Bypasses RealSmartMotionBlur creation in ProjectExporter, preventing Motion ND from rendering during export.

patches.name: Motion ND Export Bypass (FilterDispatcher)
patches.description: Bypasses RealSmartMotionBlur filter instantiation in the export filter graph dispatcher.

patches.name: Universal LUT Engine Support
patches.description: Forces supportLut getter to return true (1), enabling the LUT rendering pipeline for all footage (Single Lens, 360, Flat, Non-Log).

patches.name: Default LUT Off on Media Load
patches.description: Sets the LUT property flag to false (0) on media loading, ensuring LUT is never enabled by default until the user explicitly toggles it.

patches.name: Default Motion ND Off (Loader 1)
patches.description: Sets enableMotionBlur to false (0) on media loading, preventing Motion ND from being automatically turned on.

patches.name: Default Motion ND Off (Loader 2)
patches.description: Sets enableMotionBlur to false (0) on clip load in alternate loader.

patches.name: Default Motion ND Off (Loader 3)
patches.description: Sets enableMotionBlur to false (0) on clip load in secondary loader.

patches.name: Default Motion ND Off (Loader 4)
patches.description: Sets enableMotionBlur to false (0) on project / media open path A.

patches.name: Default Motion ND Off (Loader 5)
patches.description: Sets enableMotionBlur to false (0) on project / media open path B.

patches.name: Video Adjustments Unlock (filtersModifiable)
patches.description: Forces filtersModifiable to return true, decoupling color adjustments (Exposure, Saturation, Contrast, Color Plus) from the LUT toggle state.
patches.instructions_patched: mov al, 1; ret; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: Adjustment Reset Hook Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses the log footage callback that resets/zeroes out user color adjustments when LUT is toggled off.
patches.instructions_patched: ret; nop; nop; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: filtersModifiable Getter Unlock
patches.description: Forces MediaProcessViewModel::filtersModifiable getter to return true (1), preventing Studio from greying out or disabling color adjustments when LUT is toggled off.

patches.name: In-App Native LUT Selector Dropdown
patches.description: Embeds native ColumnLayout and Loader inside InsDrawer, enabling the expand arrow and rendering preset cards + look dropdown.
patches.instructions_patched: InsDrawer with ColumnLayout + Loader pointing to Public/L.qml

patches.name: Export Dialog Noise Reduction Toggle (SingleVideoExport.qml)
patches.description: Embeds dynamic Noise Reduction checkbox directly below Bitrate setting in videoParamsGrid, defaulting to OFF (grain preserved, 2.4x export speed) and communicating state via background service / Public flag.
patches.patched_hex: zlib stream with Denoise row below bitrate (uncompressed 49911 bytes, compressed 6659 bytes + 622 padding zeros)
patches.instructions_patched: SingleVideoExport.qml with Denoise label + InsMultiCheckBox below bitrate setting
